svg.title: M2PALS tensor algorithm: three-mode ALS loop with dictionary constraint on mode-2
svg.desc: Diagram showing M2PALS Dmult_mpnals: three mode unfoldings, ALS updates for A/B/C, MatchP_multiD atom selection on B, HALS NNLS solver details, and closed-form error formula
svg.text: order='F' critical — MATLAB reshape is column-major; C-order gives wrong index layout

g.text: while mean(diff_err_filt) > 1e-8 [filter size 3, relative change] outer iter t
alloc, idx, B ← MatchP_multiD( B_raw, D, contents )
snap B columns to best dictionary atoms — Hungarian assignment, every inner iter
C update (mode-3 unfolding, uses dict-snapped B)
= 0 when T = [[A,B,C]] exactly — verified by unit tests
precompute UtU = U.T U, UtM = U.T M
for each row k of V:
stop: nodelta ≤ delta²·eps0 where delta=1e-6 [zero-guard: if V[k,:]==0 → 1e-16·max(V)]
